title: Qur'an Pe Teer Chala
body:
Asgar pa chala yane quran pa teer chala
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hatho pe hai sarwar ke shahkaar imamat ka
Imra'n sa muhafiz hai tauhid o risalat ka
Maqtal me us hi nanhe imran pa teer chala
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Allah ne farmaya hai sab ke liye pani
Phir aale mohammed kyu haye na piye pani
Ashur ko khaaliq ke farman pa teer chala
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Cheh maah ke sin par hai khud nuh ka sin kurbaa
Woh sabr hai bachpan me yakub bhi hai giriya
Duniya ye samajti hai nadan pa teer chala
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bachpan ki adaae thi har aan ali jaisi..
Gehware mae asghar ki thi shaan ali jaisi ..
Qaba bhi laraz uttha jab shaan pa teer chala
5 Q uran hua hai para kabe ka sutu'n hai kham
Jibreel ke nauhe par jannat me hua matam
Jis waqt ke maula e rizwaan pa teer chala
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kehti hai umme rubab kaise mai jiyu beta
Khu'n mujko rulata hai khali tera gehwara
Jangal me mere nanhe sultan pa teer chala
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Asghar ki shahadat ka qonain ko sadma hai
Karbal ke fizao me "Haameed" yeh nauha hai
Haye mere shishmah e mehman pa teer chala
